biggest_catch: You earn a $100 Amazon eGift Card (not cash — Amazon eGift Cards cannot be redeemed for cash and may expire) per valid referral — and you must do the legwork: the friend must open a Rewards Checking Account, subscribe to online banking, and make 15 debit/credit card purchases in a single calendar month within 90 days of opening; capped at five paid referrals ($500) per year.
catches: Valid referral requires the friend to: (i) open a TruWest Rewards Checking Account, (ii) subscribe to online banking and accept its terms, and (iii) make 15 debit or credit card purchases in a single calendar month within the first 90 days
Both referrer and friend receive a $100 Amazon eGift Card per valid referral; rewards may be redeemed in other forms at TruWest's sole discretion
Referrer cap: five paid referrals ($500) per year
Amazon.com is not a sponsor; eGift Cards are subject to amazon.com/gc-legal terms, may expire, cannot be replaced if lost/stolen/expired
Rewards are subject to verification; TruWest may delay or refuse verification for any reason
Rewards are taxable to the participant; TruWest reports income to tax authorities as required
Employees and their families are not eligible to participate as referrers or friends
